editorial_reason: Checked Stacks Categories 4.37, Example 4.37.1 and Definition 4.37.2. The source explicitly constructs the Grothendieck category of a groupoid-valued presheaf and defines the corresponding split fibred groupoid.

definitions.text: A groupoid-valued presheaf on a category C is a contravariant pseudofunctor assigning a groupoid F(U) to each object U of C and compatible pullback functors F(U)→F(V) to arrows V→U.
A category fibred in groupoids over C is split if it is isomorphic over C to the Grothendieck construction associated with a strict contravariant functor C→Groupoids.
definitions.context_hint: Category theory: split category fibred in groupoids

editorial_reason: Checked Stacks Algebra 10.68, Definition 10.68.1, including the requirement that the final quotient module remain nonzero. This is stronger than merely requiring successive multiplication maps to be injective.

definitions.text: A finite sequence f_1,…,f_r in a ring R is M-regular for an R-module M if f_i acts injectively on M/(f_1,…,f_{i-1})M for every i and the final quotient M/(f_1,…,f_r)M is nonzero.
definitions.context_hint: Commutative algebra: regular sequence on a module

editorial_reason: Checked Stacks Algebra 10.64, Definition 10.64.1. A symbolic power is defined using localization at a prime ideal and contraction of the corresponding ordinary power.

definitions.text: For a prime ideal p of a commutative ring R and n≥0, the nth symbolic power p^(n) is the contraction to R of p^n R_p, equivalently the kernel of R→R_p/p^nR_p.
definitions.context_hint: Commutative algebra: symbolic powers of prime ideals

Checked Stacks Algebra 10.160, Definitions 10.160.1, 10.160.4 and 10.160.5. It distinguishes m-adically complete local rings, coefficient subrings with matching residue fields and the special type of complete valuation ring called a Cohen ring.

definitions.text: A local ring (R,m) is complete if the canonical homomorphism R→lim_n R/m^n is an isomorphism; equivalently, its m-adic completion introduces no new elements.
For a complete local ring (R,m) with residue characteristic p, a coefficient ring is a complete local subring Λ⊆R inducing an isomorphism of residue fields and satisfying Λ∩m=pΛ.
A Cohen ring is a complete discrete valuation ring whose maximal ideal is generated by a prime integer p.
